speak.voice: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here. Picture this: growing up with two father figures who see the world of money in completely different ways. One believes in following the traditional path—study hard, get good grades, find a stable job. The other? He’s all about breaking free, chasing financial independence, and letting money work for you, instead of the other way around. That’s the heart of Rich Dad, Poor Dad by Robert Kiyosaki—a book that pulls back the curtain on how we learn about money, and how those early lessons can shape everything we believe and do. Together, we’re about to dive into stories that’ll make you question your own ideas about wealth and risk. What if you could move from just earning a paycheck to actually building lasting assets? As we explore, you’ll discover practical wisdom, thought-provoking questions, and maybe even a few surprises about what it truly means to be rich. So, are you ready to challenge what you’ve always been told about money? Let’s take this journey together—and see how a new perspective on financial literacy can open doors to a whole new world of opportunity.
